import io
import itertools
import statistics
import sys
import zipfile
from Bio import Phylo

animals_zip, fungi_zip = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
TREE_SUFFIX = '.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile'

def mean_patristic_by_tree(zip_path, group):
    rows = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path) as archive:
        names = sorted(name for name in archive.namelist() if name.endswith(TREE_SUFFIX) and not name.endswith('/'))
        if not names:
            raise SystemExit(f'No {TREE_SUFFIX} members found for {group}')
        for name in names:
            text = archive.read(name).decode('utf-8').strip()
            if not text:
                raise SystemExit(f'Empty treefile: {name}')
            tree = Phylo.read(io.StringIO(text), 'newick')
            terminals = tree.get_terminals()
            if len(terminals) < 2:
                raise SystemExit(f'Tree has fewer than two terminal taxa: {name}')
            for clade in tree.find_clades(order='preorder'):
                if clade is tree.root:
                    continue
                if clade.branch_length is None:
                    raise SystemExit(f'Missing branch length in {name}')
            dists = [tree.distance(a, b) for a, b in itertools.combinations(terminals, 2)]
            rows.append((name, len(terminals), sum(dists) / len(dists)))
    return rows

animal_rows = mean_patristic_by_tree(animals_zip, 'animals')
fungal_rows = mean_patristic_by_tree(fungi_zip, 'fungi')
animal_median = statistics.median(row[2] for row in animal_rows)
fungal_median = statistics.median(row[2] for row in fungal_rows)
ratio = fungal_median / animal_median

with open('summary.tsv', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as out:
    out.write('metric\tvalue\n')
    out.write(f'animals_treefiles\t{len(animal_rows)}\n')
    out.write(f'fungi_treefiles\t{len(fungal_rows)}\n')
    out.write(f'animals_median_mean_patristic\t{animal_median:.17g}\n')
    out.write(f'fungi_median_mean_patristic\t{fungal_median:.17g}\n')
    out.write(f'ratio_fungi_over_animals\t{ratio:.17g}\n')
